# Host surface

<!-- Generated by `python3 -m mtport.hostsurface generate` (tools/mtport/hostsurface.py) from `work/re/imports.json`. Do not edit by hand: rerun the generator. -->

Every (class, selector) that game code sends to a framework class: what the host classes must implement ([ADR 0026](../adr/0026-objective-c-strategy.md)). Sends from Chartboost and from dead code ([objc-shell.md](objc-shell.md#how-the-shell-works)) are left out. *typed*: [#11](imports.md#objective-c-messages) knows the receiving class (or the framework class whose method an image class's send reaches); *untyped*: the receiver is unknown and no app class or category implements the selector, so `mtport.hostsurface.RECEIVERS` names the receiving class by hand. *Sends* counts the call sites.

`objc.host_surface` (tests/cpp/host_surface_test.cpp) looks every row of the areas it checks up in the runtime's registered host classes.

| Area | Classes | Selectors | Implemented by |
|---|---|---|---|
| AVFoundation | 2 | 11 | M6 |
| Foundation | 17 | 78 | #49 |
| GameKit | 5 | 20 | #52 |
| OpenGLES | 1 | 5 | #117 |
| StoreKit | 5 | 15 | #52 |
| UIKit | 17 | 129 | #54 (drawing: #51) |
